cases.question: What is the maximum travel per diem and for each night spent in a transit hotel, and for how long are medical fitness certificates required to be valid at the time of joining?
key_facts: travel per diem of USD 40 per day
for each day of travel and for each night spent in a transit hotel
3 months' remaining validity

cases.question: What are the conditions for shore leave in high-risk ports and what is the consequence of a seafarer returning on board with a blood alcohol concentration above 0.05%?
key_facts: In ports listed as high-risk in the Company Port Advisory, a curfew of 22:00 local time applies and crew must carry the Company emergency contact card.
No seafarer may return on board with a blood alcohol concentration above 0.05%

cases.question: What is the maximum number of working days of unused annual leave that can be carried over to the next calendar year?
key_facts: Up to 5 working days of unused annual leave may be carried over to the next calendar year and must be used by 31 March;

cases.question: How many days' notice must the Crewing Department give for a planned relief, and what is the maximum delay allowed before a delay allowance is paid?
key_facts: The Crewing Department will give each seafarer at least 30 days' notice of the planned relief date.
If a relief is delayed beyond the contract end date by more than 14 days, a delay allowance of USD 25 per day is paid.

cases.question: How many hours before a scheduled watch must alcohol consumption be avoided according to the document?
key_facts: a blood alcohol concentration above 0.05%

cases.question: What is the maximum extension a seafarer can have on a standard tour length?
key_facts: A tour may be extended by up to 1 month by mutual agreement

cases.question: How many working days of compassionate leave are available for the death of an immediate family member and for other relatives?
key_facts: 5 working days of paid leave on the death of an immediate family member
2 working days for other relatives

cases.question: How many days of paid leave do officers accrue per month on board if they have permanent contracts?
key_facts: Officers on permanent contracts accrue paid leave at 8 calendar days per month on board.

cases.question: What is the combined tour length for a Chief Officer (rank group) who has completed 5 years of continuous service and is entitled to 30 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year, according to the HRP-01 and CRT-03 policies?
key_facts: CRT-03 Crew Leave, Rotation and Travel Policy - fictional document for demonstration Page 1: Standard tour on board for Senior officers (Chief Officer, 2nd Engineer) is 4 months.

HRP-01 Shore Staff Leave Policy - fictional document for demonstration Page 1: Shore staff are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Employees who have completed 5 years of continuous service are entitled to 30 working days per calendar year from the start of the following year.
cases.rationale: synthesis of CRT-03_Crew_Leave_Rotation_and_Travel.pdf p.1 and HRP-01_Shore_Staff_Leave_Policy.pdf p.1

cases.question: How many calendar days of unused annual leave can be carried over to the next calendar year, and what happens to those days if not used by 31 March?
key_facts: Leave Accrual for Seafarers: Seafarers accrue paid leave at 2.5 calendar days for each month of service on board.
Carry-Over and Encashment: Up to 5 working days of unused annual leave may be carried over to the next calendar year and must be used by 31 March;
cases.rationale: synthesis of CRT-03_Crew_Leave_Rotation_and_Travel.pdf p.1 and HRP-01_Shore_Staff_Leave_Policy.pdf p.1

cases.question: How does the travel per diem policy for seafarers relate to the sick leave policy for shore staff regarding the requirement for a medical certificate?
key_facts: travel per diem of USD 40 per day is paid for each day of travel and for each night spent in a transit hotel.
A medical certificate from a registered practitioner is required for any absence of 2 or more consecutive days, and for any sick day adjacent to a public holiday or annual leave.
cases.rationale: synthesis of CRT-03_Crew_Leave_Rotation_and_Travel.pdf p.2 and HRP-01_Shore_Staff_Leave_Policy.pdf p.2

cases.question: What is the minimum number of crew members, including at least one licensed deck officer and one licensed engineer officer, required to remain on board during shore leave?
key_facts: At least one third of the crew, including one licensed deck officer and one licensed engineer officer, must remain on board at all times.
